notes.title: Playtest has ended!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Playtest is over. I gathered a lot of helpful feedback and I'll start to analyze it and see what changes people want the most.

I expect to release a public demo on Steam in around ~2 months. It will be a lot more polished and have more features/content.


Thanks to everyone for taking part!

Best regards,
Gemezl

notes.title: Playtest soon!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

It's finally time. There will be an open playtest next weekend for Nox Mortalis. Everyone can take part!


[b]Playtest starts:[/b]
Friday, May 16, 6:00 PM (GMT+1)

[b]Playtest ends:[/b]
Monday, May 19, 6:00 PM (GMT+1)


[b]Important notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Wishlist the game if you haven't already
[*]Join the discord to provide feedback and share your thoughts: [url=https://discord.gg/YW7twh4brh]Discord[/url]
[*]The playtest build only contains a small part of the game (it's like an early demo to get feedback)
[/list]


Best regards,
Gemezl
